row.body: My coat pocket entry says the well-water study workers brushed off silver specks. the mice abandoned the bin before the nurse stopped taking calls.
row.title: Coat pocket note — after Monday supper

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the silver specks while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
